display.title: Capstone: Lucifer
display.subtitle: The combat gate of Tier 3 to Tier 4
description: Lucifer is the combat capstone - the final boss of the Tier 3 boss-rush.
Two combat doors lead through him:
- Complete the full Tier 3 boss-rush (he is the last name on the list).
- Or explore and bank your way up, then simply fight and fell him.
§7The peaceful lanes (Engineering, Magic) skip Lucifer entirely -
§7banking 2000 tokens reaches Tier 4 with no fight. This is the one
